jobs.title: Facilities Technician / Technicien(ne) des installations
jobs.description_text: Télésat (Nasdaq et TSX : TSAT) est un opérateur mondial de satellites de premier plan qui fournit depuis plus de 50 ans des solutions de communication par satellite fiables et sécurisées à des clients du secteur de la radiodiffusion, des télécommunications, des entreprises et des gouvernements. Forte d'une tradition d'excellence en ingénierie, de fiabilité et de service à la clientèle de premier ordre dans le secteur, Télésat est devenue l'un des opérateurs mondiaux de satellites les plus importants et les plus prospères. Telesat Lightspeed, notre réseau révolutionnaire de satellites en orbite basse (LEO), dont la mise en service est prévue en 2027, redéfinira la connectivité mondiale à bande passante pour les utilisateurs professionnels en offrant une capacité, une sécurité et une résilience élevées, ainsi que des prix abordables, avec une latence ultra-faible et des vitesses comparables à celles de la fibre optique. Télésat a son siège social à Ottawa, au Canada, et possède des bureaux et des installations partout dans le monde. Pour en savoir plus, consultez le site www.telesat.com. English version to follow Aperçu du rôle Le ou la technicien(ne) des installations assure à ce que l’environnement du site demeure sécuritaire, fiable et pleinement opérationnel en tout temps. Ce poste convient parfaitement à une personne qui s’épanouit dans un milieu technique, qui est fière de maintenir une infrastructure à haute disponibilité et qui apprécie la résolution pratique de problèm

jobs.title: Manager, Release Management and QA
jobs.description_text: Reporting to the Director, Service Management, the successful candidate will provide technical and team leadership for the testing, quality assurance, release management, and production operations of Lightspeed business and technical applications and platforms. The candidate will be responsible for monitoring and ensuring high software quality standards throughout the systems development lifecycle and for supporting the operation of Telesat's Lightspeed production and test environments. Working closely with the Platform Engineering, Development, and IT PMO teams, the candidate will help plan, coordinate, and execute testing and production release activities while ensuring alignment with project schedules and operational requirements. The successful candidate will develop and maintain performance metrics, analyze results and trends, and present findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders to support informed decision-making and continuous improvement. Candidates must reside in the Ottawa area or be willing to relocate. Relocation assistance will be provided to qualified candidates.

jobs.title: Manager, Revenue and Receivables
jobs.description_text: Telesat (Nasdaq and TSX: TSAT) is a leading global satellite operator, providing reliable and secure satellite-delivered communications solutions worldwide to broadcast, telecommunications, corporate and government customers for over 55 years. Backed by a legacy of engineering excellence, reliability and industry-leading customer service, Telesat has grown to be one of the largest and most successful global satellite operators. Telesat Lightspeed, our revolutionary Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite network, scheduled to begin service in 2027, will revolutionize global broadband connectivity for enterprise and Government users by delivering a combination of high capacity, security, resiliency and affordability with ultra-low latency and fiber-like speeds. Telesat is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada, and has offices and facilities around the world. The company’s state-of-the-art Satellite fleet consists of 12 GEO satellites, the Canadian payload on ViaSat-1 and one LEO 3 demonstration satellite. For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The Manager, Revenue and Receivables is responsible for overseeing the revenue accounting and billing functions for Telesat and its subsidiaries, credit and collections for the Consolidated group of companies, and implementation and maintenance of revenue reporting and related controls.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator - PLM Implementation
jobs.description_text: We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Project Coordinator to initially support the implementation of a new enterprise Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) system. Reporting to the Program Management Office, the successful candidate will play a key role in coordinating project activities, maintaining governance processes, supporting stakeholder engagement, and ensuring project information is accurate, current, and accessible. This position is ideal for an individual with 3-6 years of project coordination or PMO support experience who thrives in cross-functional environments and enjoys bringing structure, organization, and accountability to complex business and technology initiatives.

jobs.title: Satellite Operations Engineer (GEO)
jobs.department: Space and Network Engineering - Satellite Operations
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The Satellite Operations Engineer (GEO) will support all engineering aspects related to ensuring effective in-orbit operations of all on-board subsystems on the assigned GEO satellite bus type(s) in order to maximize health, performance and commercial availability. The incumbent will also 1) assist in maintaining the ground RF infrastructure utilized to support satellite T&C operations, and 2) support development of automated operations products to enhance efficiencies across all facets of in-orbit operations.

jobs.title: Security System Architect
jobs.department: Lightspeed System Development - Landing Stations and User Terminals
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Security System Architect to secure next-generation satellite systems and support ground infrastructure. Reporting to the Senior Director, System Architecture and Release Train, you will lead the integration of cybersecurity across the product lifecycle, ensuring security is embedded from concept and design through deployment and operations. As a member of the System Architecture team, as the Security Champion you will work closely with Segment Domain Architects, engineering teams, and Product Cybersecurity stakeholders to ensure cybersecurity requirements are effectively incorporated into system architectures and product designs. Acting as the bridge between system architecture and cybersecurity, you will champion secure-by-design principles, assess cyber risks, and guide architectural decisions that enhance the resilience and security of space, ground, network, and cloud-based systems.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Canada Defence — Client & Program (ESCPP)
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com We are looking for an exceptional Senior Director to be the single face of this program from Telesat to DND – owning the customer relationship and orchestrating delivery from build through to operational service. If you are energized by high-stakes defence programs, thrive at the intersection of customer, commercial and engineering, and want to help shape a nation’s strategic communications capability, this is a rare and career-defining role. This is as much a technical and program-delivery leadership role as it is a customer role: you will bring genuine engineering fluency and deep program management discipline to steer a complex, multi-segment space and ground system from build through to in-service operation.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Delivery Lead
jobs.department: Lightspeed System Development - Landing Stations and User Terminals
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The Senior Engineering Delivery Manager is responsible for driving integrated engineering execution across the Core User Terminal (Core UT) platform. This role serves as the central coordination point across multiple engineering disciplines, ensuring software, hardware, integration, test, and release activities are aligned to deliver predictable, high-quality outcomes. Working within the User Terminal Engineering organization, the Senior Engineering Delivery Manager partners closely with Engineering Managers, Product Management, Program Management, Systems Engineering, Verification & Validation, Architecture teams, and the Solution-level Release Train Engineer (RTE) to manage cross-functional dependencies, integration readiness, execution risks, and release delivery. As the delivery lead for the Core UT segment, the role provides execution visibility, dependency management, release readiness, and milestone status into the broader Lightspeed Solution Train, ensuring alignment with solution-level objectives, Program Increment commitments, and release plans. This role focuses on engineering execution leadership and delivery coordination rather than direct people management, product ownership, project management, or architectural decision-making.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Embedded Software
jobs.department: Lightspeed System Development - Landing Stations and User Terminals
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com In this role, the successful candidate will be responsible to build, lead, and manage a team of software professionals, including Principal Engineers, SW. Architects, Software Engineers, Associate Engineers, as well as Scrum Masters. The right candidate will develop strategies for the embedded SW development environment, including goals and plans in alignment with the group's development objectives. They will organize and lead scrum team events (with the help of the Scrum Master), foster a collaborative and motivated work environment, and enable and support data-driven decision-making. In addition, they will provide mentorship, guidance, and career development opportunities to team members. This is a highly technical role, focused on using embedded SW development experience to successfully manage this team.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, GEO Spacecraft Operations Engineering
jobs.department: Space and Network Engineering - Satellite Operations
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com Role Overview: The Senior Manager, GEO Satellite Operations Engineering will have overall responsibility for management oversight of technical personnel supporting the Satellite Engineering and Flight Dynamics operations activities of Telesat’s in-orbit fleet of geostationary satellites. As such this role is fully responsible for ensuring the health of all spacecraft subsystems, the effective maintenance of satellite orbits and assurance of fleet-wide space situational awareness in order to maximize transponder availability and customer business needs on a 24/7 basis. The incumbent will be responsible for managing a highly specialized technical team including assigning, scheduling and ensuring proper completion of duties. This oversight includes items such as; assigning spacecraft responsibility, maneuver planning or checking roles, seasonal spacecraft adjustments, on-call duty scheduling, timeliness of spacecraft activities, maneuvers or reports and any special projects deemed essential to ensuring business continuity. In addition to delegating assignments and managing the execution, the Senior Manager will serve as a technical liaison to guide implementation, ensuring compliance with Telesat’s operational standards. This includes, on an as required basis, engineering oversight of all resources assigned to each satellite bus type. For technical discussions, impacting fleet operations, the Sr Mana

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Program Management Office
jobs.description_text: The Senior Manager, Project Management Office (PMO) reports to the Director of Mission Assurance and Program Integration and is responsible for leading enterprise program governance, integrated schedule and budget planning, program controls, portfolio reporting, and cross-segment coordination for complex telecommunications and space programs. This role provides the framework, tools, processes, and oversight necessary to enable successful program delivery across multiple organizational segments while ensuring executive leadership has clear visibility into program performance, risks, dependencies, milestones, and strategic objectives. The Senior Manager, PMO has a staff who serve as the central integrators across engineering, operations, supply chain, finance, mission assurance, product management, and other stakeholder organizations supporting multiple projects. The position does not directly manage segment Program Managers, who remain within their respective organizations and coordinate extensively with the PMO, However, the role establishes program management standards, methodologies, reporting requirements, and governance practices across the enterprise. The successful candidate must be comfortable operating in an evolving environment where not all processes, standards, and organizational interfaces have been fully established, and where success requires building structure, alignment, and operational discipline across multiple stakeholders.

jobs.title: Senior Network Management Software Developer
jobs.department: Lightspeed System Development - Landing Stations and User Terminals
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com As a Senior NMS Software Developer, you will lead the design, development, and evolution of Lightspeed's Network Management and OSS platforms, enabling service fulfillment, assurance, automation, and observability across a carrier-grade LEO satellite network. You will leverage modern software engineering practices, cloud-native technologies, and AI-assisted development tools.

jobs.title: Senior Trainer, Instructional Design & Training
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Senior Trainer, Instructional Design & Training to join our team, reporting directly to the GTM PMO & Business Operations Head. In this senior role, you will lead the design, development, and delivery of high-quality training programs and enablement materials for Telesat’s Business Support System (BSS) and the Canadian Department of National Defence (DND) customer under the Enhanced Satellite Communication Project (ESCP) — a major contract award. You will be accountable for the full training deliverable set, spanning the BSS, LEO Mission and Network Operations training and User Terminal (UT) operations and field maintenance training, translating complex technical content into structured, self-paced, and instructor-led curricula that meet Canada’s accessibility, format, and Learning Management System requirements. If you are a proactive learning professional with a passion for building operational readiness and a proven track record delivering training in demanding, mission-critical defence environments, we encourage you to apply and help us achieve our strategic goals.

jobs.title: Senior User Terminal System Engineer
jobs.department: Lightspeed System Development - Landing Stations and User Terminals
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com Telesat is seeking a motivated User Terminal System Engineer to support the development, integration, verification, and documentation of Lightspeed User Terminal solutions. This role provides exposure to advanced satellite communications, government and enterprise applications, mission-critical terminal use cases, and a range of suppliers. The successful candidate will work under the guidance of experienced systems engineers while taking increasing ownership of defined work packages.

jobs.title: TCC Technologist
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The Technical Control Centre (TCC) Technologist works as part of a large team providing network surveillance, control, pro-active corrective and preventative maintenance support to Telesat's customers on a 24 hour, 7 day basis. The TCC technologist proactively monitors network services and fixed satellite service customers, and manages the troubleshooting and investigation of reported faults until services have been restored. They perform hands-on corrective and preventative measures to Allan Park earth station critical systems, TT&C ground communications equipment, and on-site customer services.

jobs.title: Technical Program Integration Lead
jobs.description_text: The Technical Program Integration Lead serves as the focal point for integrated planning and execution within a major program segment, product area, or technical domain This role bridges technical complexity and program execution by transforming multiple engineering, product, software, hardware, operations, integration, and supplier workstreams into a cohesive, executable, and measurable program plan. Working across technical teams, systems engineering, program management, and program controls organizations, the Senior Technical Program Integration Lead ensures scope, dependencies, risks, readiness criteria, and delivery commitments are accurately represented within the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) and broader program framework Unlike a traditional Project Manager or Integrated Program Controls Analysts, this role drives technical planning maturity, cross-functional alignment, and execution discipline while ensuring technical teams operate as a fully integrated part of the overall program The role is accountable for establishing and maintaining a credible, integrated execution plan, identifying, and proposing workarounds and mitigations for risks and dependencies early, and enabling leadership to make informed decisions based on clear assessments of program readiness and execution health Success in this position requires strong technical acumen, systems-level thinking, and the ability to influence diverse stakeholders toward a common execution strategy

jobs.title: Technical Writer, User Terminal (UT) Engineering
jobs.department: Lightspeed System Development - Landing Stations and User Terminals
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The Technical Writer will support the User Terminal (UT) Engineering team by developing, maintaining, and improving technical documentation throughout the product lifecycle for Telesat Lightspeed User Terminals. The role will work closely with product managers, engineers, subject matter experts, and UT leadership to ensure documentation is accurate, consistent, traceable, and professionally presented. The successful candidate will be responsible for transforming complex technical information into clear, structured documentation suitable for engineering teams, suppliers, integrators, manufacturing partners, and internal stakeholders. The role will help refine documentation standards, improve document quality, manage document reviews, and ensure requirements traceability across the UT product portfolio.

jobs.title: User Terminal Program Manager, Mil-Ka
jobs.department: Lightspeed System Development - Landing Stations and User Terminals
jobs.description_text: As User Terminal (UT) Program Manager, Mil-Ka, this position will join the User Terminal development team responsible for the development, integration, qualification, delivery, and deployment of Mil-Ka user terminal solutions supporting Telesat Lightspeed government and defence programs. The UT Program Manager, Mil-Ka will lead the programmatic execution of external vendor terminal development programs and serve as a primary interface between Telesat and its user terminal suppliers. The role will coordinate closely with Telesat engineering, product management, systems engineering, PMO, procurement, contracts, and other stakeholders to ensure terminal solutions meet technical, schedule, cost, quality, and program objectives. This role requires a seasoned program manager with demonstrated experience managing complex satellite communications or similar hardware/software development programs through design, integration, verification, manufacturing readiness, delivery, and deployment. Experience developing satellite communications equipment or user terminals for government, defence, or other mission-critical applications is highly desirable. Success in this role requires a proactive, results-driven program manager with a high degree of initiative and strong communication skills, able to drive execution across cross-functional organizations and external suppliers while operating effectively in a complex government program environment.

jobs.title: User Terminal System Engineering Specialist
jobs.department: Lightspeed System Development - Landing Stations and User Terminals
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com Telesat is seeking an experienced User Terminal System Engineering Specialist to support systems engineering for Lightspeed User Terminal products and applications. This role will focus on requirements development and maintenance, Product Requirements Document support, architecture definition, requirements traceability, verification planning, and cross-functional coordination across engineering, supplier, and program teams. The successful candidate will work independently with internal teams, suppliers, and program stakeholders to ensure requirements are complete, testable, traceable, and aligned with customer and product objectives.

jobs.title: QuantCo AI Builder Grant
jobs.description_text: QuantCo is offering up to ten AI Builder Grants to exceptional Bachelor’s and Master’s students enrolled at universities in Austria, Germany, and Switzerland . Grant recipients will receive a Max 5x subscription for Claude over five months, valued at over $500 per person to power their own AI projects, explore emerging tools, and gain exposure to state-of-the-art developments in artificial intelligence. At QuantCo, our global teams of quants, AI and software engineers collaborate heavily with state-of-the-art AI tooling to build scalable, high-impact solutions for enterprise clients . We are introducing this grant to bridge the gap between academic environments and real-world coding best practices, helping eager students accelerate their technical skills outside the classroom . Whether you have previously competed in hackathons or are simply excited about building innovative projects, we encourage all ambitious students to apply and join us in shaping the AI transition . To apply, please submit your CV and transcripts. We review applications on a rolling basis and will get back to you within a week of your submission. If you have any questions, please reach out to join@quantco.com .

jobs.title: Consultant — Enterprise Change & Transformation
jobs.description_text: The Enterprise Change & Transformation Consultant builds organizations' capacity to change continuously — not just to land a single initiative. Rather than executing one-off communication and training plans for a discrete rollout, this role helps clients stand up durable change capability: Centers of Excellence, self-service playbooks, and manager-led change practices that make the organization resilient to constant transformation, well beyond any one project's go-live date. Consistent with AHEAD's Consultant capability tier, this role is the engine of an engagement: day-to-day contact for analyst- and manager-level client stakeholders, and owner of a discrete enterprise change and transformation deliverable or workstream. The Consultant structures sub-problems, develops hypotheses, and produces client-ready work with limited supervision, while beginning to informally coach Associates.

jobs.title: Director of Supply Chain
jobs.description_text: The Director of Supply Chain continually works to maximize the value generated by the AHEAD Foundry supply chain by optimizing the flow of goods and information between vendors, AHEAD Foundry, and customers. They strengthen and expand vendor relationships, maintain efficient inventory levels, and work closely with sales to develop strong forecasting disciplines. They are keenly aware of market trends in computer server components and work closely with vendors on supply-side planning. They work to reduce logistics and warehousing costs while developing accurate, vital metrics with which to measure success and ongoing progress. They oversee all purchasing, warehousing, and logistics functions, along with key vendor relationships, and lead a team of Buyers with varying degrees of responsibility and specialties

jobs.title: Director, Financial Solutions
jobs.description_text: AHEAD is seeking a Director, Financial Solutions to join our Financial Solutions Group (FSG). This role supports a geographic territory aligned with sales and partners closely with sales leadership, clients, accounts receivable, manufacturers, and internal finance teams. The Director, Financial Solutions helps AHEAD structure strategic financing solutions, improve cash outcomes, support complex transactions, and enable financial selling across the business. The ideal candidate combines strong financial-selling experience with commercial judgment, analytical rigor, and the ability to communicate effectively with both internal and external stakeholders.

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description_text: As a Field Marketing Manager, you will lead the development and execution of integrated marketing plans that generate awareness and drive pipeline growth across AHEAD’s Central Region. This highly collaborative role partners closely with marketing, sales, and external agencies to align strategy, ensure flawless execution, and report on performance and outcomes. Serving as the primary bridge between the Central Region and the broader marketing organization, you will ensure tight coordination across teams, consistency in messaging and branding, and effective activation of campaigns, partner initiatives, and regional deliverables. You’ll also champion regional engagement in national campaigns—helping to localize content, refine audience targeting, and align messaging to meet regional business needs. The ideal candidate brings a strong track record in field marketing and a hands-on approach to execution. This position reports directly to the Director of Field Marketing. It offers a unique opportunity to make a direct and measurable impact on regional business growth.

jobs.title: Financed Contracts Billing and Collections Specialist
jobs.description_text: The Financed Contracts Billing and Collections Specialist manages the billing, payment tracking, collections, reconciliation, and cash-application activities associated with customer-financed receivables. This role owns the operational flow from approved financing documentation through invoice submission, payment follow-up, reconciliation, and funding or cash application. The specialist works closely with AHEAD’s Finance and Accounting Department, Financial Solutions Group, Financial Solutions Leads (FSLs), and leasing partners to ensure that financed transactions are billed accurately, payments are collected on time, records remain complete and traceable, and exceptions are resolved through the appropriate financial channels. This is a hands-on role for a highly organized, detail-oriented professional who is comfortable working with contract and financial data and confident managing professional businessto-business payment communications.

jobs.title: Launch Associate, Product Engineer

LAUNCH serves as the foundation to develop our talent into high potential leaders at AHEAD. jobs.title: Lead Hardware Returns Specialist
jobs.description_text: The Lead Hardware Returns Specialist is responsible for leading the daily processing of defective, damaged, non-conforming, and customer-owned computer hardware for return to manufacturers and vendors. This role performs the core functions of the Hardware Returns Specialist while providing day-to-day direction, coordination, training, and operational support for the returns team. Ensures accurate product verification, documentation, inventory control, RMA processing, vendor returns, and outbound shipments. The role is also responsible for monitoring department performance, resolving process issues, supporting cross-functional communication, and helping maintain consistent operations across multiple facilities located on the same campus.The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, process-driven, technically capable, and able to lead by example in a fast-paced warehouse and reverse-logistics environment. The position requires flexibility to work in and provide coverage for multiple campus facilities as business needs require.

jobs.description_text: ウーブン・バイ・トヨタについて ウーブン・バイ・トヨタは、トヨタの100年に一度のモビリティ・カンパニーへの変革に寄与していきます。「自分以外の誰かのために」発明を続けたという歴史からインスピレーションを受けた私たちのミッションーそれは、モビリティの定義を拡げ、そしてモビリティが社会に貢献する方法を拡張し、人を想うイノベーションで、モビリティの常識に挑み続けることです。 私たちは4つの柱を中心に活動しています：自動運転・先進運転支援システム技術のAD/ADAS、SDV（ソフトウェア定義車両）のための車両ソフトウェア生産プラットフォームであるArene、モビリティのテストコースであるWoven City、そして協業基盤を支えるデジタル・インフラストラクチャのCloud & AIです。また、ビジネスに不可欠な機能がこれらのチームの実装を下支えし、一丸となって「事故ゼロ社会」と「幸せの量産」の実現に向けて取り組んでいます。 ========================================================================= チームについて Teammate Driving (POV BEV) チームは、自動運転システムにおける最も基本的な機能の1つである車線維持機能と、自動運転システムで使用される地図情報提供サービスを開発しています。テストエンジニアのミッションは、システム要件に基づいて実装されたソフトウェアの機能、性能、品質基準を設定し、評価し、設計者にフィードバックし、製品の性能と品質を向上させることです。また、これらの製品をトヨタの次世代運転支援システム「Toyota Safety Sense」と「Teammate」に実装し、世界中の顧客により安全な運転とより快適なモビリティを提供します。 求める人材 私たちは、ソフトウェアのパフォーマンスと品質を向上させるために、AD/ADAS車両評価の運用と問題分析を行い、問題解決を推進できるエンジニアを探しています。また、ソフトウェアエンジニア、テストドライバ、さまざまな協力者と良好な関係を築くために、新しい価値を提案し、効果的にコミュニケーションできる人材を求めています。尚、定期的に東京・日本橋のオフィスに出社し、静岡県東富士のテストコースで実地試験の実施が必要となります。 業務内容 プロジェクトの進捗状況に合わせた評価計画の策定と管理 システム要件を満たすテストシナリオの作成 実車でのテストと特定された問題の原因の特定 アジャイル開発における問題管理と解決の推進 必須条件 以下のスキルと経験が必要です。 ・技術 ・車両評価業務 ・ユーザー視点でソフトウェア要件が満たされていることを検証する能力 ・Gitによるソフトウェア管理能力 ・AD（自動運転）/ADAS（先進運転支援システム）に関する知識と各技術の相互作用の理解 ・管理 ・優れた問題解決能力、仮説検証能力、タスク管理能力 ・ドキュメンテーション能力 ・さまざまな情報を体系化し、首尾一貫した計画を立案する能力 ・言語 ・日常的な場面で使われる日本語を理解できる能力。（例：日本語能力試験N2以上、または同等のレベル）

jobs.title: AI-First Engineering Intern
jobs.description_text: Why This Role Exists Xsolla is going all-in on becoming an AI-first company, and we're not waiting for a slow rollout to get there. We're offering AI Engineer Internships in regions across the globe to help drive that shift directly, not by sitting in the back office, but by building. You'll work on two things: Internal AI initiatives – helping unlock AI tooling and integrations across Xsolla faster than our existing teams can alone. Proof-of-concept builds on our own APIs – showing our product and engineering teams what's possible when you build with AI as a core part of your workflow, not an afterthought. This isn't a shadow-and-observe internship. You'll ship code that goes to customers – internal teams or external players and game developers – working closely with senior engineers and fellow interns across our global regions. Who You'll Work With You won't be isolated on an intern-only project island. You'll work closely with senior engineers who are actively rebuilding how we write software, and you'll be part of a global cohort of interns building in parallel across our regions. That combination is the point: senior engineers give you a bar for what production-grade, customer-facing code looks like, and your fellow interns give you a peer group to trade ideas, code, and AI workflows every week.

jobs.description_text: About Xsolla Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. About the Role We're looking for a Staff Engineer to own the smart wallet and account abstraction layer of Xsolla's Web3 platform. This is an individual contributor role with outsized technical scope: you'll be the technical anchor for how millions of players get an on-chain account they never have to think about — setting direction, making hard architectural calls, and raising the bar across the org. Concretely, you'll own the account model behind Xsolla ZK, our zkSync-based L2, and the wallet that sits inside Xsolla App. Every player who signs in with Xsolla ID receives a deterministic, non-custodial smart account — derived from their identity claim, identical on every device, with private keys that never leave the client. That account is not a separate "wallet" screen: it is the player's inventory, and it backs minting, gifting, trading on our Bazaar marketplace, Merkle-based reward airdrops, gas sponsorship, and an in-app dApp browser that exposes the same signer to third-party applications through an EIP-1193 provider. You'll own the primitives underneath all of it: the ERC-4337 user operation lifecycle, EIP-7702 delegation, session keys and origin-bound Smart Sessions, paymaster and gas abstraction strategy, and the custody and recovery roadmap — including the move from raw key export to MPC custody. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, System Orchestration
jobs.description_text: Location: Oxford, UK Office commitment: Hybrid The Role: We are looking for a highly technical Staff Software Engineer to join our System Orchestration team in System Software at Oxford Ionics. In this role, you will be responsible for building and operating the software that keeps our systems calibrated, decides what they do next and keeps the record of what they did, contributing to the team's mission of keeping our quantum computers running useful work around the clock. The trapped-ion quantum computers we are building will control 10,000 ions within two years, and all of that has to be kept in tune - settings that drift over minutes, hours and days. Without it a computer does not stop; it quietly starts producing invalid output. Calibration routines, scientists' experiments and customer workloads all compete for physical hardware, and our team builds the control plane that arbitrates that: it schedules and prioritises programs, hands exclusive access to one at a time and takes it back cooperatively, streams results while a program is still running, and keeps the record of everything that ran. It runs on every quantum computer in our fleet. Its job is to keep that machine busy and productive: running quantum programs rather than waiting in between, and running them in spec - on a machine still hitting the fidelity it is meant to hit. The ambition is for that to run without a person in the loop: machines that assess their own readiness, call for the calibrations they need,

jobs.description_text: We are hiring a Brand Lead to own how Pairs shows up wherever a founder or investor looks us up: AI assistants, search, the press, and every page in between. THE ROLE Founders and investors research us before they speak to us. They ask ChatGPT and Perplexity, they read the AI summary at the top of a Google search, and they check what the press and directories say. This role owns all of it. You write the work yourself, place it yourself, and measure it against the conversations it brings in, not impressions. You report to the two co-founders and work alongside the rest of our brand and content team. The organisation is flat, and the public record of this company is yours to build. WHAT YOU WILL OWN The citable layer. Answer pages, comparison pages and a newsroom, written so AI engines and journalists quote Pairs as the source. Search and AI visibility. The company record. One description of Pairs, identical on every platform and directory, and kept that way. Reputation. Public sentiment handled calmly and by each platform's rules
